The green beans cover roughly 15 cm by 7 cm and look about 1.5 cm thick, so I estimate about 100 g. The spinach is about 30 g of fresh leaves. The oil, zest, and onion add roughly 10 g, which makes the total about 140 g.

For energy, roasted green beans run about 60 kcal per 100 g, so 100 g gives about 60 kcal. The spinach adds about 7 kcal. Visible oil, perhaps 1 tsp, adds about 40 kcal, and the other toppings add about 10 kcal. That comes to about 117 kcal, which I'll round to 120.
